_comment: KB manager config. Copy to <manager.folder>/kb.config.json (default 00_KB_Manager/kb.config.json) and fill the values. Every path is relative to the repository root. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_request_prefixes: File-name prefixes of request files. Every prefix is read (open requests, duplicates); the first one is used for new files. Default ["REQ-", "KB-REQ-"] (2.0.4; new files use REQ-). To rename later, put the new prefix first and keep the old one.
_policy_file: Empty = the default rules only (<manager.folder>/templates/kb-policy.default.md). A project policy file adds to the default rules, never loosens them.
_search_model: none = no model (default). local = experimental slot only (.qkb/models/); search does not change in bundle 1.0.
_hooks: mode: observe (log only, first week) | on (show notes) | off. log: true = log in observe and on (no prompt text, no KB content); log_dir: empty = observe_log_dir. Other keys: see hooks/kbcommon.py DEFAULT_HOOKS.
